verdict.rationale: Extend documents an official CLI at docs.extend.ai/cli, confirmed by probe, covering parse, extract, classify, split, edit, detect-form, workflows run, batch, and output/scripting. Its Agent Quickstart includes a path to equip an agent that runs the CLI, which fits the AI-native framing. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of the CLI, and details beyond section headings (installation and authentication specifics for the CLI).
